title: Smt. Afiya Khatoon v. State of U.P. and others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta and Prashant Kumar, JJ.
disposition: Petition disposed; notice withdrawn; fresh order under Supply Code.
headnote: Writ challenging a provisional-assessment recovery notice disposed of as nothing survived once the Electricity Department withdrew the notice and undertook to pass a fresh order after hearing, strictly in accordance with the procedure under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Smt. Afiya Khatoon challenged a notice of provisional assessment dated 6 November 2019 issued by the Electricity Department and the recovery proceedings based on it. On 16 May 2023 the Court gave the Department time to obtain instructions, adjourned the writ to 29 May 2023, and restrained coercive action in the meantime. On the adjourned date counsel stated that the recovery notice had been withdrawn so that a fresh order could be passed after hearing her, and placed a communication sent by respondent no. 3 to the Tehsil authorities.

holding_units.topic: Provisional assessment; fresh order after hearing
holding_units.holding: Where the Electricity Department withdraws the recovery notice on a provisional assessment and states that a fresh order will be passed after opportunity of hearing, nothing survives in the writ. The petition is disposed of with liberty to pass that fresh order strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

principle_tags.application: The petition was disposed of with liberty to the Electricity Department to pass a fresh order, after hearing, strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

not_decided.point: Merits of the provisional assessment dated 6 November 2019 and of any fresh liability
not_decided.note: The notice stood withdrawn. The Court did not examine the assessment and left a fresh order, after hearing, to the Department.
